card.name: "As" before monotherapy or single agent
card.fires_on: The word "as" (or "a" in "as a") right after a drug name, where the next words are "monotherapy" or "a single agent", often contrasted with combination use.

modes.label: may be used as
modes.description: "as" after a drug name and "used" or "administered", leading into monotherapy or combination.
modes.example: OLUMIANT may be used<< as>> monotherapy or in combination with methot

modes.label: as a single agent
modes.description: "a" in "drug as a Single Agent" headings.
modes.example: RYBREVANT as<< a>> Single Agent In CHRYSALIS,

card.writes: It pushes toward words for treatment regimens and combinations, such as 方案, combo and 组合.
card.plain: It fires when a label says a drug is given alone or with other drugs, just at the word "as".
